classifier_contract.blindness: Each fresh classifier receives one pass packet only, with randomized card IDs and feature order, no source or candidate identities, no answer key, no prior pass, and no repository access.
classifier_contract.prohibited_inference: Do not infer, name, or search for authors, disciplines, source works, candidate identities, authentic-card count, composite construction, or an intended winner.
classifier_contract.score_scale: Use integers 1 through 5. A coherence score of 5 requires mutually reinforcing features that imply one specific register; a 3 indicates a plausible but partly generic or mixed bundle; a 1 indicates conflicting or unrelated features. A separation score of 5 requires multiple independent distinguishing cues; a 3 requires a reliable but narrow distinction; a 1 means effectively indistinguishable.
classifier_contract.task: Score each anonymous card independently for internal coherence and non-neutral distinctiveness, score all twenty-one unordered card pairs for linguistic-profile separation, then identify the most neutral card. Some cards may be coherent profiles and some may be matched composites; do not assume how many of either exist.
